mode: descriptive positive-cell feature shift audit; no fitting or p-values

definition.positive: at least one fixed-source bear report in Apr 1–Sep 30; same 100m cell rule
definition.yearly_distribution: static feature values among that year's positive cells only
definition.quantiles: finite values only; nonfinite counted as missing and never imputed
definition.ks: two-sample KS statistic, no p-value decision
definition.top5: descending abs(Cliff's delta), feature name tie-break

tree.unit: fraction of valid WorldCover pixels in 100m cell

crop.unit: fraction of valid WorldCover pixels in 100m cell

built.unit: fraction of valid WorldCover pixels in 100m cell

grass.unit: fraction of valid WorldCover pixels in 100m cell

water.unit: fraction of valid WorldCover pixels in 100m cell

bldg_500.unit: OSM building centroids in square window

limitations: feature surfaces are fixed; differences describe which cells became positive, not temporal changes in those surfaces
correlated features and reporting/position biases may affect shifts
distribution shift alone does not establish why predictive capture changed
